headline: Is S&P Global’s (SPGI) Adaptive Retrieval Quietly Redefining Its Role in Enterprise AI Workflows?
summary: S&P Global Inc. recently launched Adaptive Retrieval, an AI-ready service that lets customer agents and large language models assemble licensed S&P Global data via natural language through its AI Data Portal, complementing the existing Deterministic Retrieval offering. This move deepens S&P Global’s role at the center of AI-driven workflows by turning its pre-cited, auditable datasets into plug-and-play infrastructure for enterprise-grade AI applications.
